# Failure Clusters

## Cluster 1: Formula-Induced / Value Mismatch (High Leverage)
- Tasks: 267-18, 43436, 50768, 51-12
- Root Cause: Either writing formulas instead of values, or incorrect calculation logic.
- 267-18: The agent wrote a script but might have missed the exact literal value or used a formula (though the trace shows it trying to use literals). The grader says it failed because of formulas.
- 43436: Logic for "open records" might be slightly off.
- 50768: Matrix mapping might be shifted or incorrect.
- 51-12: Logic for "counting increases" might be off.

## Cluster 2: Data Range / Position Mismatch (Medium Leverage)
- Tasks: 227-40, 37456, 48527
- Root Cause: Agent failed to identify the correct rows/columns or wrote to the wrong place.
- 227-40: Wrote to A14:E17 but might have used the wrong source rows or didn't match the expected output exactly.
- 37456: Target range G12:J15 was empty in output.
- 48527: Condition A==B was used, but the provided content suggested a different "unique" logic.

## Cluster 3: State/Read Mismatch (Low Leverage)
- Tasks: 9726
- Root Cause: Sheet was byte-identical to input; nothing was written.
- 9726: Agent wrote a long script but maybe failed to save or used the wrong output path (though it looked correct).
